content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched a new Valet accessory, describing it as a "wireless charging station and personal belongings tray."

Now Twelve South is further expanding the Valet series with a new, more compact model that supports MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging, with speeds of up to 25W.

The first-generation Valet unveiled earlier this year measured 7.5 inches, allowing you to set down your phone, keys, wallet, glasses and other everyday carry items. However, the new-generation Valet is significantly more compact at just 4.25 inches.

Below is Twelve South's description of the Valet's exquisite design:

The Valet is first and foremost a beautiful home accent piece, and only secondly a precision wireless charger. It combines warm materials with modern craftsmanship to create a calmer, more refined aesthetic that fits anywhere in the home—from the entryway console, to the kitchen, to the bedside table. The soft, square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray, while the weighted zinc-alloy base keeps everything stable and neatly in place.

In terms of functionality, the compact Valet has more than enough charging power for your iPhone, and also features a built-in extra USB-C port for conveniently charging other accessories at the same time:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather catch tray
  • Four interchangeable orientation options
  • Detachable leather bezel for easy replacement
  • Weighted zinc-alloy base with concealed cable management
  • Additional USB-C port supporting up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes a 45W power adapter and a 1.5-metre USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is now available for pre-order at US$129.99, offered in three colour combinations. It's not cheap, but it provides a stylish and practical spot to charge your phone while also holding your glasses, wallet or keys.
